title: Adopt t3code agent-workflow tricks (changed-only verify, context ratchet, replay fixtures, worktree markers)
body:
Operator (2026-11-06): "w kodzie ... poszukaj sztuczek w pracy agentowej i potencjalnie znajdź co nam sie moze przydać"; grant: "wszystkie triki od theo są dozwolone szefie, to musi być superior tool".
Recon of pingdotgg/t3code: .krn/runs/lead/t3code-agentic/report.md (ranked). Candidates, each its own slice, proof = measured on a real slice:
1. Changed-only verify with cached verdict per diff (t3code scripts/check-changed.ts) -> `krn verify --changed`. M.
2. Agent context budget ratchet (agentContextBudget.json + CI job): instruction bytes may not grow without a label; KRN has context:report. S.
3. Codex app-server JSON-RPC transcript replay fixtures for src/hosts/codex-app-server.ts (KRN-12 receiver proof). M.
4. Lint rules instead of prose: no sleep/poll/retry in tests; skip needs `// quarantine: <task>`. S-M.
5. Review agents as md files with model/globs/budget/requires: Check; PRs adding suppressions need a human. S-M.
6. Worktree setup markers (setup-running/done/failed + PID) so agents wait instead of racing installs — fixes "new worktrees lack node_modules". S.
7. AGENTS.md craft: "ways to hurt yourself", "hit every surface" checklist, tests at the lowest failing layer. S.
First slice suggestion: 2+4+6.
